title: Disable Log dose button without a selected person and medication
description: The onClick handler already silently no-ops if selectedProfile/selectedMedication are null (e.g. no profiles or medications exist yet), but the button stays tappable with no visual feedback. Making it explicitly enabled = ... makes 'you can't log a dose without a person and a medication' a visible, enforced UI state instead of a silent failure.
acceptance_criteria: The Button call gains enabled = selectedProfile != null && selectedMedication != null
The existing onClick logic (including its own null-check before calling onSubmit) is unchanged
exact_code:
Button(
                enabled = selectedProfile != null && selectedMedication != null,
